entries.title: II Samuel 7:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass when the king was dwelling in his house, and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies all around,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:2
segments: that the king said to Nathan the prophet, "See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwells inside tent curtains."

entries.title: II Samuel 7:3
segments: Then Nathan said to the king, "Go, do all that [is] in your heart, for the LORD [is] with you."

entries.title: II Samuel 7:4
segments: ¶But it happened that night that the word of the LORD came to Nathan, saying,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:5
segments: "Go and tell My servant David, 'Thus says the LORD: "Would you build a house for Me to dwell in?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:6
segments: "For I have not dwelt in a house since the time that I brought the children of Israel up from Egypt, even to this day, but have moved about in a tent and in a tabernacle.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:7
segments: "Wherever I have moved about with all the children of Israel, have I ever spoken a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people Israel, saying, 'Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?'"'

entries.title: II Samuel 7:8
segments: "Now therefore, thus shall you say to My servant David, 'Thus says the LORD of hosts: "I took you from the sheepfold, from following the sheep, to be ruler over My people, over Israel.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:9
segments: "And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a great name, like the name of the great men who [are] on the earth.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:10
segments: "Moreover I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own and move no more; nor shall the sons of wickedness oppress them anymore, as previously,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:11
segments: "since the time that I commanded judges [to be] over My people Israel, and have caused you to rest from all your enemies. Also the LORD tells you that He will make you a house.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:12
segments: "When your days are fulfilled and you rest with your fathers, I will set up your seed after you, who will come from your body, and I will establish his kingdom.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:13
segments: "He shall build a house for My name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:14
segments: "I will be his Father, and he shall be My son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:15
segments: "But My mercy shall not depart from him, as I took [it] from Saul, whom I removed from before you.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:16
segments: "And your house and your kingdom shall be established forever before you. Your throne shall be established forever."'"

entries.title: II Samuel 7:17
segments: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:18
segments: ¶Then King David went in and sat before the LORD; and he said: "Who [am] I, O Lord GOD? And what is my house, that You have brought me this far?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:19
segments: "And yet this was a small thing in Your sight, O Lord GOD; and You have also spoken of Your servant's house for a great while to come. [Is] this the manner of man, O Lord GOD?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:20
segments: "Now what more can David say to You? For You, Lord GOD, know Your servant.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:21
segments: "For Your word's sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all these great things, to make Your servant know [them].

entries.title: II Samuel 7:22
segments: "Therefore You are great, O LORD GOD. For [there is] none like You, nor [is there any] God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:23
segments: "And who [is] like Your people, like Israel, the one nation on the earth whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people, to make for Himself a name-and to do for Youself great and awesome deeds for Your land-before Your people whom You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt, the nations, and their gods?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:24
segments: "For You have made Your people Israel Your very own people forever; and You, LORD, have become their God.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:25
segments: "Now, O LORD God, the word which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house, establish [it] forever and do as You have said.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:26
segments: "So let Your name be magnified forever, saying, 'The LORD of hosts [is] the God over Israel.' And let the house of Your servant David be established before You.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:27
segments: "For You, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, have revealed [this] to Your servant, saying, 'I will build you a house.' Therefore Your servant has found it in his heart to pray this prayer to You.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:28
segments: "And now, O Lord GOD, You are God, and Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:29
segments: "Now therefore, let it please You to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You; for You, O Lord GOD, have spoken [it], and with Your blessing let the house of Your servant be blessed forever."
